item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 09 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip. Eleven to eighteen, partly cloudy, and zero millimetres of rain. Zero. After yesterday's forty-six millimetre biblical soaking the sky has decided to behave itself. Wind six metres a second. Light jacket, no umbrella, go outside like a functioning adult. The…

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 02 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip today, fourteen to twenty, grey lid, five and a half millimetres of rain, wind to eight metres a second. Correction, because this forecast has lied to me three days running: yesterday I promised you twelve millimetres and a proper soaking, and it is half that.…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 15 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Fourteen to twenty-two degrees in Ruislip today, three millimetres of rain, barely any wind. Twenty-two degrees in mid-September is your mate who announces he's leaving the party and then stands by the door for an hour. It isn't summer, it isn't autumn, it's a…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 08 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip. Thirteen to seventeen degrees and forty-five point eight millimetres of rain. Forty-five. That is not a shower, that is a soaking, ten times the wettest other day this week. And the label on it? Clear sky. Clear bloody sky. Somebody has stapled two days…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 01 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip today, twelve to twenty, solid grey lid, no rain, no wind worth the name. Twenty and cloudy is the weather equivalent of being told your table will be ready shortly. It's nothing. It's beige. Take the jacket you'll resent carrying, because you will carry it.…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 10 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Right. Yesterday I told you Thursday was six millimetres of rain. It is eleven point three. I nearly doubled it overnight, so whatever coat you picked on the strength of six, upgrade it. Today is a proper soaking: ten to eighteen degrees, cloud the colour of wet…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 03 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip today, eighteen to twenty-four, cloudy, three point three millimetres of rain. Correction, four days running now: yesterday I promised it would warm and dry at once. Half right. Twenty-four, yes. Dry, absolutely not. Rain at twenty-four degrees, the muggy…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 13 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Eighteen point nine millimetres of rain today, eighteen degrees to twenty-two. Twenty-two degrees. And pissing down. That is not rain, that is a warm shower you did not ask for and cannot turn off. Coat on, arrive sweating. Coat off, arrive soaked. No third door. This…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 12 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Today is the good one. Twelve up to twenty-two, cloudy, under a millimetre of rain. Go out, get the washing dry, because tomorrow you are going nowhere. Sunday brings fourteen and a half millimetres of rain at twenty-two degrees. Warm rain. Twenty-two degrees of it.…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 05 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip. Twelve to twenty-two, partly cloudy, not one millimetre of rain. Twenty-two and dry in September is the weather being polite, which should frighten you, because it never lasts. Twelve at dawn, twenty-two by lunch, so layers, and no, the shorts stay in the…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 14 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip. Seventeen to twenty-three today, partly cloudy, five point four millimetres of rain. Warm and damp, so you'll sweat inside the coat you put on for the drizzle. Now. Tomorrow's forecast says clear sky. It also says eleven millimetres of rain. Eleven. That is not…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 07 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip. Seventeen to twenty-one and raining, seven millimetres of it, so summer is formally over. Get the coat you have been pretending you do not need. Then look at tomorrow, where the forecast has written the words "clear sky" next to thirty-seven point seven…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 11 September 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Right. Fifteen to twenty-one degrees, partly cloudy, a tenth of a millimetre of rain. That is not rain, that is a rumour of rain. Light jacket, no umbrella, crack on. Yesterday I told you today would be two point two millimetres and it is nought point one, so let us…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 04 September 2026
item.description: Weather. Ruislip today, fourteen to twenty, cloudy, two point two millimetres. Correction time, now a standing feature. Yesterday I promised Friday was the wet one, four and a half millimetres. It is two point two. I overcharged you by half. I also sold you low twenties. It is…
